description: Engine-neutral game QA scenarios. Bind controls, setup, and assertions to each game's design.

testcases.title: Cold launch reaches a usable first screen
setup: Close prior game process
Start from a clean test profile when supported
steps: Wait for the first stable menu or playable screen
expected: Process remains alive through startup
A configured stable UI label or visual anchor is detected
Screenshot and run report are saved

testcases.title: Primary navigation responds to configured input
setup: Reach a screen with a known focusable control
Configure the game's confirm and navigation keys
steps: Wait for the expected next screen
expected: Input changes focus or screen state
Expected destination text or visual anchor appears

testcases.title: Pause and resume preserve a valid session
setup: Enter a safe playable state
Configure pause and resume controls
expected: Pause state is visible
Resume returns to the active session without a crash

testcases.title: Window focus loss and regain do not corrupt input state
setup: Enter a safe state
Use an external focus-switch step if required
expected: Game remains responsive
No stuck movement or held key is observed

testcases.title: Restart returns to a valid initial state
setup: Reach a safe checkpoint or menu
Configure restart flow
steps: Restart using the supported in-game flow
expected: Expected initial UI is restored
Run can continue without stale or duplicated state

testcases.title: Inventory capacity and item boundaries
steps: Add items up to the documented limit
expected: Capacity is enforced
Rejected item remains available or has a clear failure result
Freed capacity accepts the next item

testcases.title: Movement, camera bounds, and collision smoke
steps: Move against a nearby solid boundary
expected: Character or vehicle responds to mapped controls
Camera remains within expected limits
Movement does not pass through the configured collision boundary

testcases.title: Platform traversal, footing, and ledge recovery
setup: Use a repeatable checkpoint
Document movement, jump, grab, and crouch controls
Identify a safe ledge/traversal segment
steps: Capture the player footing and next landing surface
Issue one short movement or jump action
Verify landing/grounded state using an approved game oracle or visible evidence
Repeat at a configured ledge and recover from one controlled fall
expected: The character lands only on reachable surfaces
No input is sent when footing or hazard state is ambiguous
A fall returns to the configured checkpoint
Every transition has screenshot or Unreal telemetry evidence

testcases.title: Stealth hiding and patrol exposure
setup: Use a repeatable patrol encounter
Document the hiding control and exposed/hidden oracle
steps: Wait for the patrol to pass
Exit only after the case-defined safe condition is observed
expected: The player remains hidden during the configured exposure window
The patrol does not detect the player while the approved hidden state is active
An ambiguous patrol or hiding state produces no movement input

testcases.title: Puzzle interaction and reset behavior
steps: Interact with a known puzzle object
Submit one valid and one invalid answer
Reset or leave and re-enter the puzzle
expected: Valid action advances the puzzle
Invalid action does not grant completion
Reset state matches the game's documented rules

testcases.title: Simulation settings persist after reopening
steps: Restart the game if persistence is expected
expected: Setting remains at the expected value and is visible after reopening

testcases.title: Race start, lap progression, and finish state
steps: Complete a lap or configured segment
expected: Progress indicator advances
Finish state appears once
Result screen reflects the run outcome

testcases.title: Dialogue advance, choice selection, and save/load
steps: Select each branch in separate clean runs
Save, return to title, and load the save
expected: Dialogue advances once per input
Selected branch is reflected in subsequent text
Loaded state matches saved chapter and choice state

testcases.title: Follow an approved FMV story branch to its expected destination
setup: Select a known starting save or chapter
Record the target build and locale
Use only a choice with an approved expected destination
steps: Play until the configured choice appears
Wait for the next stable scene
expected: The selected option is recorded
The resulting scene matches the configured destination
No unrelated branch is entered

testcases.title: Verify an FMV subtitle against its approved cue and time range
setup: Provide the approved subtitle text/key and cue time range
Set the target locale and display resolution
steps: Play the clip through the cue start and end
Capture frames while the subtitle is visible
Compare displayed text and timing with the approved cue
expected: The expected text is visible in the target locale
The cue appears and disappears within configured timing tolerance
Text is not clipped or overlapped by another subtitle

testcases.title: Complete a configured FMV mini-game and verify its outcome
setup: Document the mini-game rules, controls, time limit, and expected success state
Use a repeatable starting point where available
steps: Observe the resulting success or failure state
expected: Inputs follow the configured controls
The mini-game ends within the documented time limit
The resulting game state matches the expected outcome

testcases.title: Check FMV playback continuity and transition to the next scene
setup: Record the expected clip and next scene IDs
Use the intended playback resolution
steps: Allow passive playback to the transition
Observe playback and the first stable frame of the next scene
expected: Playback advances without a sustained frozen or black frame
The expected next scene appears
No unconfigured input skips a choice or changes the branch

testcases.title: Session join, disconnect, and reconnect
setup: Use isolated test server and test accounts
Record session and build identifiers
steps: Disconnect using a controlled network interruption
Repeat with expired or invalid session data
expected: Valid session can be joined
Disconnect state is communicated
Reconnect follows documented recovery rules
Invalid session is rejected without corrupting account state

testcases.title: Purchase and reward accounting boundaries
applies_to: games with currency, rewards, or shop
setup: Use disposable test account and deterministic backend fixtures
steps: Attempt purchase one unit above balance
expected: Valid purchase updates balance and inventory exactly once
Insufficient balance purchase is rejected
Repeated reward claim does not duplicate grant
